relayAdapterBoundary.invocation: The Relay broker calls startDeliveryAdapter({client, bind, signal, root, onEvidence}) in the broker process; the OpenCode plugin connects over an authenticated private Unix socket.
relayAdapterBoundary.finding: The broker intentionally receives no native SDK/plugin context. The Relay-owned OpenCode plugin runs inside its v2 PluginContext and hands exact session/profile/lifecycle identity plus explicit Relay authority/worker/session/epoch bindings through the private bridge to the existing bind callback. The original smoke used a test bind callback; the later v2.0.27 archive-installed probe used the real supervisor/store and observed native notice admission/context/primary request, an exact completed model reply, and safe idle. Its package-directory observation wrapper and zero-priced inference plugin are test-only. Other clients remain unimplemented.
relayAdapterBoundary.smallestRequiredAuthorization: OpenCode deployment remains owner-controlled: enable the exported plugin only in an approved isolated profile, grant only explicitly approved native permissions, and supply an explicit existing Relay recipient mapping in plugin options. This stage made no host configuration or permission changes.

clients.surface: Managed hooks and Cursor Agent SDK
clients.launch: not an adapter capability; existing local Pool/prime only

Cloud busy rejects rather than queues; local agents do not raise AgentBusyError, and local.force expires a stuck run rather than providing safe busy delivery.
clients.smallestNextStep: Provide an exact-session bridge plus version-matched current status, refusal, safe-boundary, and request-identity semantics for the installed Agent CLI.

clients.surface: Kilo v2 session inbox/prompt API candidate
clients.launch: not an adapter capability; existing local Pool/prime only
clients.apiFinding: The candidate v2 API is not matched to CLI 7.8.8. Replaying the same message ID returns the original admission but schedules another wake unless resume:false, which admits only; sessions.active() is process-local and resets on restart. Backlog/steering bounds, provider timeouts, current status/refusal, and safe busy behavior remain unresolved.
clients.smallestNextStep: Provide a version-matched exact-session API with bounded queue/provider behavior, no unsafe duplicate wake on retry, and current status/refusal/observation semantics.

clients.surface: Hermes 2026.9.24 in-process Python PluginContext.inject_message on an exact native session key
clients.launch: not an adapter capability; existing local Pool/prime only
clients.apiFinding: inject_message is callable only inside PluginContext and returns a boolean scheduling result, not an attempt-correlated receipt. Gateway injection requires allow_gateway_injection. The inspected surface lacks caller-keyed idempotency, fresh exact-session status, and correlated context/turn observation; a generic bridge cannot supply these native guarantees. The classic CLI busy path can interrupt and is not suitable for unattended delivery.
clients.smallestNextStep: An explicitly supported native surface must provide caller-keyed idempotent enqueue plus fresh exact-session status and correlated context/turn observation. Any plugin installation or permission grant remains separately owner-authorized.

clients.launch: not an adapter capability; existing local Pool/prime only
clients.apiFinding: The actual npm archive was installed offline. The earlier wrapper-loaded idle result remains separate; a subsequent direct src/adapters directory configuration loaded the canonical index.mjs entry without wrapping Relay or overlaying the installed archive. Native inventory reported the plugin active and the real supervisor/store verified its exact binding. A committed string notice reached the same previously idle session; native readback matched its admission and excluded the queued payload. A zero-priced owner-approved inference route produced an exact completed reply. Ordered native observations and safe idle were persisted, and three reconciliations retained the pending message without another attempt. Full busy/refusal/restart qualification remains open; registry/Git selectors were not exercised.
clients.smallestNextStep: Qualify native input-submission refusal, other permission cases, restart/uncertain recovery, and remaining D04/runtime cases in isolated sessions. Controlled-context, one genuinely model-invoked tool boundary, and one real read-permission hold/rejection now have separate successful delivery receipts; earlier failures remain intact. Do not spoof provider headers, inherit credentials, use a real user session, or substitute a synthetic provider receipt. Host deployment and permissions remain owner-controlled.
